blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Association of Women in Radio and Television–Philippines (IAWRT) on Tuesday defended the journalists’ right to report Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment proceedings. The group also criticized her camp for alleged “veiled threats.” This came after defense lawyer Mark Vinluan enumerated the penalties under the Anti-Money Laundering Act while cross-examining prosecution witness Atty. Ronel Buenaventura during Monday’s impeachment hearing. Buenaventura is the executive director of the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC) Secretariat, “We take exception to Atty. Mark Vinluan’s veiled threat to journalists covering the impeachment proceedings,” the association said in a statement released on Tuesday. It added, […]...
